published_source: No printed value for this regression: Table 6, Panel C of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2021.03484.pdf, p. 1228) prints the UTSA coefficient only in column (2), 0.112 (t 2.01), N 9,953, which is the authors' est3 (do-file line 1130) WITH time-varying firm and state controls; the specification is the authors' no-controls regression est1 (line 1128), which the article does not print. Authors' code output for est1 in authors_code_* (0.12203102 (0.052613), N 9,953). Read Nov 4 2026. Earlier: Printed Table 6, Panel C, column (2) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2021.03484.pdf, p. 1228), read Nov 4 2026: UTSA 0.112** with the t-statistic 2.01 in parentheses (no SE printed, so published_se = null), Observations 9,953, 'Time-varying firm and state controls: Yes'. In the printed Panel C, column (1) is the site-level EMS adoption regression (N 151,286, no UTSA coefficient) and the EMS integration_FE regression on UTSA is column (2); the spec's 'column 1' refers to the do-file's est1 (line 1128, no controls), whereas the printed column is est3 (line 1130, with the Table 2 firm and state controls, the only estimate outreg2 keeps). Differs from the code output 0.12203102 (SE 0.052613, t 2.32) of line 1128: the printed column adds the time-varying firm and state controls. Earlier: Authors' ABH_main_tests.do line 1128 (Table 6 Panel C column 1: reghdfe erp_group2 utsa_dummy, absorb(gvkey sic2#year) cluster(group_state_id)) re-run in Stata MP 16.1 on the shipped Table6PanelC_data.dta; the published PDF is not available in the project. erp_group2 is missing for 5,343 of 15,522 rows; reghdfe drops 226 further singleton observations (N 9,953, 49 clusters, adj. R2 0.5756). fixest gives the same coefficient (SE 0.0527962 with singletons dropped, 0.0533957 keeping them).
replication_status: exact (authors' code est1, do-file line 1128, reproduced: 0.12203102 (0.052613), N 9,953; no printed value for this regression, the printed Table 6 Panel C column (2) adds time-varying controls, see published_source; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
notes: Alternative EMS-integration outcome built from site-level characteristics (first stage not disclosed). Same firm-year panel as Table 2 (identifiers, utsa_dummy, sic2 and state agree row by row with sample_ready_to_test_MS.dta); 10,179 rows with non-missing erp_group2 before singleton drops, 1,533 firms. sic2 constant within firm. Non-missing sample: 383 never-treated firms, 1,071 always-treated, 79 firm-level switchers (cohorts 2000, 2001, 2003-2006, 2008, 2009; TN 2000 and PA 2004 are the genuine law adoptions, the rest are HQ movers); 61 switch-off rows dropped by run_spec.R. Outcome SD in the authors' regression sample 0.5181788, so authors' coef / SD = 0.23550.
